Be calm as this impressive hour,
And lead to endless day.

(Chorus)

511b.lyrics:
Whene’er I cross the stream of death,
I’ll be happy with the blest,
For Jesus, Christ, the Son of God,
Came to earth to die for me.
I love to tell of that sweet home,
O glory to the Lamb of God,
And this I know, I’m on my way,
To the home prepared for me.

For some sweet day, some happy day,
I will join the happy throng,
Farewell, dear friends, I’m going home,
For my Saviour bids me come.
For I’m a pilgrim on my way,
To that sweet home of endless day,
O let us sing and praise the Lord,
For the gift of His dear Son.

512.lyrics:
My God is real, oh, yes, He’s real,
My friend, oh, can’t you see?
He made the heavens and the earth,
The little birds and the trees.

Chorus:

Oh, how wonderful,
What a wonderful day that will be.

He bled and died upon the cross
For sinners like you and me,
He raised old Laz’rus from the grave,
He set Paul and Silas free.

(Chorus)

He said one day He would return,
My friends, don’t you believe?
He’s coming back just like He said,
A wonderful day that will be.

(Chorus)

513t.lyrics:
Oh, for a closer walk with God!
A calm and heav’nly frame!
A light to shine upon the road
That leads me to the Lamb.

Chorus:

I do believe with all my heart
That Jesus died for me,
He died, the Friend of sinners died,
Poor sinners now, rejoice.

Where is the blessedness I knew
When first I saw the Lord?
Where is the soul-refreshing view
Of Jesus and His word?

(Chorus)

What peaceful hours I then enjoyed!
How sweet their mem’ry still!
But now I find an aching void,
The world can never fill.

(Chorus)

So shall my walk be close with God,
Calm and serene my frame;
So purer light shall mark the road,
That leads me to the Lamb.

513b.lyrics:
O what amazing words of grace
Are in the gospel found;
Suited to ev’ry sinner’s case,
Who knows the joyful sound.

Poor, sinful, needy, thirsty souls
Are freely welcomed here;
Salvation like a river rolls,
Abundant, free and clear.

‘Whoever will,’ O gracious word!
Shall of this stream partake;
Come thirsty souls, and bless the Lord,
And drink for Jesus’ sake.

514.lyrics:
Dear brethren, I have found,
A land which doth abound,
With fruits as sweet as manna,
The more I eat I find,
The more I am inclined,
To sing and shout ‘hosanna!’
My soul doth long to go,
Where it may fully know,
The glory of the Savior;
And as I pass along,
I’ll sing the Christian’s song,
I hope to live forever.

What must this fountain be,
From which grace flows so free,
It yields both peace and pleasure;
There’s no terrestrial bliss,
Can ever equal this,
A foretaste of my Savior.
My soul doth long to go,
Where it may fully know,
The glory of the Savior;
And as I pass along,
I’ll sing the Christian’s song,
I hope to live forever.

metadata.Title: When the Lord Shall Come for Me
metadata.Collation: When the Lord Shall Come for Me

516.lyrics:
Spirit Divine, attend our pray’rs,
And make this house Thy home;
Descend with all Thy gracious pow’rs,
Oh come, Great Spirit, come!
Come as the light; to us reveal
Our emptiness and woe;
And lead us in those paths of life
Where all the righteous go.

Come as the dove, and spread thy wings,
The wings of peaceful love;
And let Thy church on earth become
Blest as Thy church above.
Come as the fire, and purge our hearts
Like sacrificial flame;
Let our whole soul an off’ring be
To our Redeemer’s name.

517.lyrics:
The Savior stands and pleads for thee,
Behold the dying Son,
When Jesus comes a crown we’ll wear,
And we’ll be gathered home.

518.lyrics:
There is beauty all around,
When there’s love at home;
There is joy in ev’ry sound,
When there’s love at home.
Peace and plenty here abide,
Smiling fair on ev’ry side;
Time doth softly, sweetly glide,
When there’s love at home.

Chorus:

Love at home, love at home;
Time doth softly, sweetly glide,
When there’s love at home.

In the cottage there is joy,
When there’s love at home;
Hate and envy ne’er annoy,
When there’s love at home.
Roses blossom ’neath our feet,
All the earth’s a garden sweet;
Making life a bliss complete
When there’s love at home.

(Chorus)

Kindly heaven smiles above,
When there’s love at home;
All the earth is filled with love,
When there’s love at home.
Sweeter sings the brooklet by,
Brighter beams the azure sky;
O, there’s One who smiles on high,
When there’s love at home.

(Chorus)

Jesus make me wholly Thine,
Then there’s love at home;
May Thy sacrifice be mine,
Then there’s love at home.
Safely from all harm I’ll rest,
With no sinful care distressed
Thro’ Thy tender mercy blessed,
When there’s love at home.

(Chorus)

519.lyrics:
I have a father way in glory,
One by one we’ll gather home.

Chorus:

Gathering, gathering,
One by one we’ll gather home.

I have a mother way in glory,
One by one we’ll gather home.

(Chorus)

I have a brother way in glory,
One by one we’ll gather home.

(Chorus)

I have a sister way in glory,
One by one we’ll gather home.

(Chorus)

When Christ will say, ‘Well done,’ my brother,
One by one we’ll gather home.

(Chorus)

520.lyrics:
Stand ye in the way, and see, and ask
For the old paths where is the good way,
Therein shall ye find rest for your soul.

Chorus:

Come unto me all ye that labor,
Come unto me ye heavy laden,
And I will give you rest.
Take up my yoke and learn of me
For I am meek and lowly in heart,
And find rest unto your soul.

Love the Lord, your God, with all your heart
And your soul, and your mind, and your strength,
And your neighbor love, love as yourself.

521.lyrics:
Life’s sun is sinking down,
The shade of night draws nigh,
In death we’ll soon be found,
To meet the Lord on high.

Chorus:

O time speed on and bring the hour,
When I shall meet with Christ in pow’r;
Yes, let me then to glory rise,
And wear a crown beyond the skies.

When time shall be no more,
And we from sin are free;
The Lord we will adore,
Thro’ one eternity.

(Chorus)

What joy, indeed, to know,
For me is waiting there,
Inside those pearly gates,
A golden crown to wear.

(Chorus)

522.lyrics:
The shades of night are drawing near,
Life’s sun so fast is passing by;
We soon death’s river o’er must steer,
For all life lives, but once, then dies.

Chorus:

O shades of night so soon pass o’er
And let the light of heaven shine,
That we in realms of bliss may soar,
And then the praise shall all be Thine.

Sure is the road that leads to death,
And soon our earthly joys will fly,
The life of man is short at best,
And pleasures only bloom to die.

(Chorus)

524.lyrics:
While tenting here I have no home,
I’ll work and toil ’till death shall come,
For in this world I find no rest,
I’ll seek a home among the blest.

Chorus:

O Lord, if I must live this life,
Then let me spend my days for Christ;
Let not my work of life be vain,
Lord help me sing a sweeter strain,
O Lord if I must live this life,
Pray help me spend my days for Christ.

My home is not beneath the skies,
Where tempests rage and storms arise;
I have a home that’s built above,
Where all is peace, and joy and love.

(Chorus)

There in that home above the skies,
They know no aches, or sobs, or sighs;
But all is joy and peace and love,
And Christ shall lead the host above.

(Chorus)

526.lyrics:
There’ll be joy in heaven when we reach that land,
And we’ll sing with the angels fair,
There with Christ who’s gone to prepare a home,
And shall see His glories over there.

Chorus:

Oh, may we meet in heaven,
On Canaan’s happy shore,
To sing aloud his praises
With joy for evermore.

Then we’ll meet our loved ones on that shining shore’
And we’ll dwell with them on high,
What a happy time when we all reach heav’n
Singing hallelujah by and by.

(Chorus)

527.lyrics:
Lord, when together here we meet,
And taste Thy heav’nly grace,
Thy smiles are so divinely sweet,
We’re loathe to leave the place.

Yet, Father, since it is Thy will,
That we must part again,
Oh let Thy gracious pardon still
With ev’ry soul remain.

528t.lyrics:
Go forth, ye heralds, in My Name,
Sweetly the gospel trumpet sound;
The glorious jubilee proclaim,
Where’er the human race is found.

The joyful news to all impart,
And teach them where salvation lies;
With care bind up the broken heart,
And wipe the tears from weeping eyes.

528b.lyrics:
A few more days on earth to spend,
And all my toils and cares shall end;
And I shall see my God and friend,
And praise and sing for evermore.

Then, O my soul, despond no more,
The storm of life will soon be o’er,
And I shall find the peaceful shore
Of everlasting heav’nly rest.

529.lyrics:
When Jesus calls me I must go,
And leave my loved ones here below;
But when I reach that home above,
I’ll rest forever in His love.

Chorus:

When Jesus calls,
Then I will go
To that bright home above,
Where all is joy and peace and love,
And live for evermore.

The Savior stands and bids thee come,
Directs you to Jerusalem;
Where none but saints and angels dwell,
While sinners have their part in hell.

(Chorus)

And when I reach that heav’nly home,
In this vain world no more to roam,
I’ll walk the golden streets and sing,
And praise my Savior, Lord and King.

(Chorus)

530.lyrics:
Thro’ a sinful world I journey,
Dangers thick on ev’ry side,
Seeing not the path before me,
Knowing not what shall betide;
Oh, I need a guide and helper,
One who can my foes withstand,
This the pray’r I lift to heaven,
Give me God’s unchanging hand.

Chorus:

Give me God’s unchanging hand,
Give me God’s unchanging hand,
While I live and when I’m dying,
Give me God’s unchanging hand;
I’m a pilgrim, I’m a stranger,
In a dark and dreary land,
’Till I reach the gates of glory,
Give me God’s unchanging hand.

Earthly friends may soon forsake us,
Clouds may darken all my sky,
But there’s One above all others,
Who can ev’ry need supply;
He is called the friend of sinners,
Our salvation He has planned,
Unto Him my spirit whispers,
Give me God’s unchanging hand.

(Chorus)

I am poor, dear Lord, and helpless,
Let me lay my hand in Thine,
Let me feel Thy strength unfailing,
Let me trust Thy love divine;
’Till by angels bright attended,
I shall reach the golden strand,
Grant, O, grant my soul’s petition,
Give me God’s unchanging hand.

(Chorus)

metadata.Title: O Jesus, Ever with Us Stay
metadata.Collation: O Jesus, Ever with Us Stay
metadata.Tune Composer: Cagle, Alfred Marcus; Allen, Thomas Jefferson (arranger)

532.lyrics:
Jesus, and shall it ever be,
A mortal man ashamed of Thee?

Chorus:

O Jesus, ever with us stay,
Make all our moments calm and bright,
Chase the dark night of sin away,
Shed o’er the world Thy holy light.

Ashamed of Thee whom angels praise,
Whose glories shine through endless days.

(Chorus)

533.lyrics:
Weak is the effort of my heart,
And cold my warmest tho’ts;
But when I see Thee as Thou art,
I’ll praise Thee as I ought.

Chorus:

Ye seed of Israel’s chosen race,
Ye ransomed of the fall;
Hail Him who saves you by His Grace,
And crown him Lord of all.

’Till then I would Thy love proclaim,
With ev’ry fleeting breath;
And may the music of Thy name,
Refresh my soul in death.

(Chorus)

metadata.Title: The Saints Will Be Gathered There
metadata.Collation: Saints Will Be Gathered There, The

534.lyrics:
I want my friends to go with me
To that eternal home,
Where we shall be forever there,
And sing around the throne.
The saints will all be gathered there,
For evermore to stay,
We’ll talk and sing about His love,
On that great judgment day.

535t.lyrics:
My Christian friends to whom I speak,
I have a crown in view.
My sinner friends, now will you seek,
How stands the case with you?
I know there is a paradise,
The saints all bid us come.
And He who reigns, rules earth and sky,
O heaven is my home.

535b.lyrics:
My life on earth is out,
My work on earth is done,
And I’ll go home to my Maker and rest,
I feel my road is clear,
O Savior, take me home.

metadata.Title: Thy Love
metadata.Tune Composer: Jenks, Stephen; Shaw, John Malcolm Cruse (arranger)

536.lyrics:
Talk with us, Lord, Thyself reveal
While here on earth we rove.
Speak to our hearts and let us feel
The kindling of Thy love.

537.lyrics:
I am walking with my Savior ev’ry day,
Praise the Lord, O praise the Lord;
And He’s promised to go with me all the way,
Praise the Lord, O praise the Lord.

Chorus:

Praise the Lord on high, O praise the Lord on high,
Hallelujah! praise ye the Lord on high.

When I’m weary then He gives me blessed rest,
Praise the Lord, O praise the Lord;
And in tender love He holds me to His breast,
Praise the Lord, O praise the Lord.

(Chorus)

Soon He’ll lead me home to glory ne’er to roam,
Praise the Lord, O praise the Lord;
To that place of blessing on the happy shore,
Praise the Lord, O praise the Lord.

(Chorus)

538.lyrics:
Come, dear brethren, praise your Jesus,
Praise Him, praise Him evermore;
May His great love now constrain us,
His great name for to adore.
Oh, then let us join together,
Crown of glory to obtain,
He is Christ and our salvation,
He is our exalted King.

539.lyrics:
Farewell, dear brothers, fare you well,
Pray, do not weep for me,
I’m going home with Christ to dwell,
Throughout eternity.
When I get home to that bright world,
And meet my Savior there,
And all the loved ones gone before,
I’ll no more shed a tear.

Chorus:

I am marching away,
To that great judgment day.
Farewell to all below,
For I’m called, I must go.

Dear sister, thou are left alone,
But thou art kind and true,
And when God calls you to come home,
I hope to meet with you.
Thus we’ll surround the great white throne,
And dwell forever there,
And sing God’s praise through endless days,
From sorrow, pain and care.

(Chorus)

Dear father, you’ve been kind to me,
When I was young and wild,
But now, dear father, do not weep,
Forgive your dying child.
O, father, don’t forget my wife,
My children, my dear ones,
The time has come when I must say,
Farewell, farewell to all.

(Chorus)

My loving mother, fare you well,
But do not fear alarm,
The Savior dear is always near,
To shield you from all harm.
Yet may we meet and be complete
With all the blood washed throng,
And cast our crown at Jesus’ feet,
And sing redemption’s song.

(Chorus)

540.lyrics:
There’s a land beyond the river,
Where the skies are ever fair;
And I have an angel mother,
Who is waiting for me there.

Chorus:

Come, O boatman, row me over,
To a fairer land than this;
For my heart grows weary waiting,
For my angel mother’s kiss.

She went o’er the silent waters,
At the setting of the sun;
And I know that she is happy,
For the Christian’s course is run.

(Chorus)

In that land where she is waiting,
For the ones she loved on earth;
Sin and sorrow never enter,
But eternal days have birth.

(Chorus)

When the solemn summons calls us,
To the mansions of the blest;
We shall lose our earthly sorrows,
In a sense of blissful rest.

(Chorus)

metadata.Title: I’m Going Home to Die No More
metadata.Collation: I’m Going Home to Die No More

541.lyrics:
Why should we start or fear to die,
What tim’rous worms we mortals are,
Death is the gate to endless joy,
And yet we fear to enter there.

Chorus:

I’m going home to die no more,
When this mortal life is o’er;
I’m going home to die no more,
Yes, I’m going home to die no more.

The pains, the groans, the dying strife,
Fright our approaching souls away,
Again our souls spring back to life,
Fond of its prison and its clay,

(Chorus)

Jesus can make a dying bed
Feel soft as downy pillows are,
And on His breast I’ll lay my head,
And breathe my life out sweetly there.

(Chorus)

542.lyrics:
Are you ready for the day,
That is coming by and by,
When the saints of earth shall gather over there;
Can we face the heav’nly band,
With the saints in glory stand,
When the roll is called up yonder on that day?

Chorus:

On that day, the judgment day,
Will we all then ready be?
When He comes, the Savior comes,
On that awful judgment day.

When the final day shall dawn,
And the glorious King shall come,
And our earthly time has swiftly passed away;
Will you hear the sinner’s cry,
Will you hear the King’s reply,
Will you see the heav’nly mansions built on high?

(Chorus)

Will we all then ready be,
When the glorious King we see,
And the host of saints comes forth in bright array;
Oh the joy that we shall know,
What hosannahs we’ll outpour,
When we meet our loved ones on that final day.

(Chorus)

543.lyrics:
There then to Thee Thine own I leave,
Mould as Thou wilt Thy passive clay;
But let me all Thy stamp receive,
But let me all Thy words obey:
Serve with a single heart and eye,
And to Thy glory live or die.

My ev’ry weak, tho’ good design,
O’errule, or change, as seems thee meet;
Jesus, let all my work be Thine.
Thy work, O Lord, is all complete:
And pleasing in thy Father’s sight;
Thou only hast done all things right.

metadata.Title: My Eternal Home
metadata.Tune Composer: Montague, W. L.; Hughes, H. D. (arranger)

544.lyrics:
My Father’s house on high,
Is my eternal home,
O God forbid that I should fail,
While trav’ling here below.

Chorus:

Then join the heav’nly throng,
To sing redeeming love,
While endless ages roll along,
We’ll praise our God above.

My Father and my God,
Oh lead me safely on,
Till in that heav’nly world above,
I feel my work is done.

(Chorus)

545.lyrics:
I need not feel one anxious thought,
Or know one pressing care,
But that I may —His word has taught,
Take unto Him in pray’r.

Chorus:

I have a precious friend,
Who keeps me day by day;
On whom my hopes of heav’n depend,
Who is my guide and stay.

O sinner, take Him for your friend,
His grace is free to all,
He will the trusting soul defend,
Nor suffer it to fall.

(Chorus)

’Tis sweet to feel His presence near,
And on His strength rely,
To know that He through life will cheer,
Support when death is nigh.

(Chorus)

546.lyrics:
Dark and stormy is the desert,
Thro’ which pilgrims make their way,
Just beyond this vale of sorrow,
Lies the fields of endless day.

Chorus:

Farther on, but how much farther?
Count the milestones one by one,
Jesus will forsake us never,
It is better farther on.

There on flow’ry hills of pleasure,
Lie the fields of endless rest;
Love and joy peace forever,
Reign and triumph in each breast.

(Chorus)

547.lyrics:
We have our troubles here below,
And travel thro’ this world of woe,
To that bright world where angels dwell,
Where all is peace and love.

Chorus:

Where all is peace and love,
To that bright world where angels dwell,
Where all is peace and love.
Where all is peace and love,
To guide my weary feet above,
Where all is peace and love.

I feel no way like getting tired,
I’m trusting in His holy word,
To guide my weary feet above,
Where all is peace and love.

(Chorus)

548.lyrics:
To thee the gracious Lord and King,
We lift our voice aloud and sing,
Thou art the God of host above,
On earth you are the God of Love.
High was Thy throne e’er heav’n was made,
Or earth Thy humble footstool laid.

549.lyrics:
When we have crossed the stream of death,
O let us sing and praise the Lord,
For Jesus Christ, the Son of God,
Came down to earth to die for me.

Chorus:

I love to tell of that sweet home,
O glory to the Lamb of God.

For some sweet time I’m going home,
To join the praise of endless joy,
Of this I know, I’m on my way,
To that sweet home prepared for me.

(Chorus)

metadata.Title: Gone Home
metadata.Tune Composer: Dale, W. T. (Rev.); Allen, Thomas Jefferson (arranger)

550.lyrics:
Oh, where is now our brother dear?
Gone home to mansions bright and fair;
No more he’ll shed the bitter tear;
He’s happy in his mansion there.

Chorus:

Gone home, gone home,
With Jesus there to dwell;
Gone home, gone home,
His praises there to swell.

No more he’ll meet us here below;
His toil and sacrifice are o’er;
And by the river’s gentle flow,
He stands upon the golden shore.

(Chorus)

But though he’ll visit us no more,
Yet may we go to Him at last;
And then we’ll sing our troubles o’er,
When all life’s labors here are past.

(Chorus)

Farewell, dear brother, ’till we meet
Before the throne of God above;
And cast our crowns at Jesus’ feet,
And sing the triumph of His love.

(Chorus)

551.lyrics:
There is a holy city,
A happy world above;
Beyond the starry regions,
Built by the God of love.
And everlasting temples,
And saints arrayed in white,
They serve their great Redeemer,
And dwell with Him in light.

That is no world of trouble,
The God of peace is there;
He wipes away their sorrows,
He banishes their care.
Their joys are still increasing,
Their songs are ever new,
They praise th’eternal Father,
The Son and Spirit, too.

552.lyrics:
Should earth against my soul engage,
And fiery darts be hurled,
Then I can smile at Satan’s rage,
And face a frowning world.
So pilgrims, we are marching home,
On earth no more to stay,
Long for the welcome call to come,
And live thro’ endless day.

553.lyrics:
The hill of Zion yields,
A thousand sacred sweets,
Before we reach the heav’nly fields,
Or walk the golden streets.

Then let our songs abound,
And ev’ry tear be dry;
We’re marching thro’ Immanuel’s ground,
To fairer worlds on high.

metadata.Title: Where the Soul Shall Never Die
metadata.Collation: Where the Soul Shall Never Die

554.lyrics:
Our mother’s gone to heaven,
To a mansion bright and fair;
Her picture hangs up yonder,
But there’s a vacant chair.
We’re on our way to Canaan,
To that sweet home on high,
We’ll shout and sing forever,
Where the soul shall never die.

She’s gone up there with Jesus,
There forever more to stay;
So I trust in God to meet her,
In a better world some day.
She has crossed o’er Jordan’s river,
Safe on the other side,
But when we get to heaven,
Then the gates will open wide.

We know the Savior’s coming,
Coming in the clouds someday;
We believe the Bible story,
To catch His bride away.
We only hear the message,
When He is passing by,
He’ll take us all up yonder,
To that bright land on high.

metadata.Title: Praise the Redeemer
metadata.Tune Composer: Cagle, Alfred Marcus; Allen, Thomas Jefferson (arranger)

555.lyrics:
From all that dwell below the skies,
Let the Redeemer’s praise arise,
Let the Creator’s name be sung,
Thro’ ev’ry land by ev’ry tongue.

Chorus:

Praise God from whom all blessings flow,
Praise Him all creatures here below,
Praise Him above, ye heav’nly host,
Praise Father, Son and Holy Ghost.

Eternal are Thy mercies, Lord,
Eternal truth attends Thy word;
Thy praise shall sound from shore to shore,
’Till suns shall rise and set no more.

(Chorus)

556.lyrics:
O, for a heart to praise my God,
A heart from sin set free;
A heart that always feels Thy blood,
So freely shed for me.

A heart resigned, submissive, meek,
My great Redeemer’s throne;
Where only Christ is heard to speak,
Where Jesus reigns alone.

O, for a lowly, contrite heart,
Believing, true and clean;
Which neither life nor death can part,
From Him that dwells within.

557.lyrics:
On Jordan’s stormy banks I stand,
An cast a wishful eye,
To Canaan’s fair and happy land,
Where my possessions lie.

Chorus:

I am bound, yes I’m bound,
I am bound for the promised land;
Won’t you come and go with me?
I am bound for the promised land.

558.lyrics:
I’ll praise my Master while I’ve breath,
I hope to praise Him after death,
I hope to praise Him when I die,
And shout salvation as I fly.

I soon shall pass the vale of death,
And in His arms I’ll lose my breath,
And then my happy soul shall tell
My Jesus hath done all things well.

Then I shall see my blessed God,
And praise Him in His bright abode,
My theme in blest eternity,
Shall glory, glory, glory be.

559.lyrics:
I am going home today
In the narrow gospel way;
Soon I’ll be at rest above,
There to sing redeeming love.

Chorus:

With the angels I shall stand,
In that holy happy land,
Brother, will you meet me there?
Heaven’s joys with me to share.

Jesus will me pilot be,
O’er the dark uncertain sea;
With all pain and sorrow past,
I will anchor safe at last.

(Chorus)

In my blessed Savior’s arms,
I’ll be safe from all alarms;
From all suff’ring I’ll be free,
Brother will you be with me?

(Chorus)

560.lyrics:
My life flows on in endless song
Above earth’s cares and woes,
I catch the sweet tho’ far-off hymn,
That points to heav’n above.

Chorus:

Singing, I journey on my way,
Toward the shining shore;
There I shall see His loving face,
And praise Him evermore.

Through all the tumult and the strife
I hear sweet music ring,
It finds an echo in my heart,
I’ll trust and hope and sing.

(Chorus)

I lift my eyes, the clouds grow thin,
I see the blue above,
And day by day this pathway smooths,
Since I first learned of love.

(Chorus)

561.lyrics:
Yes, I think I hear my Saviour calling me,
And I think I see Him hanging on a tree;
O the Lamb of Calvary, and His blood He shed for me,
And I know my Savior’s calling now.

Chorus:

Calling now, calling now,
Yes I love to think of my Jesus as my Friend,
Calling now, calling now,
He has promised to be with us to the end.

metadata.Title: On To Calvary
metadata.Lyrics: Beck, George L. (1st Verse); Medley, Samuel (2nd Verse)

562.lyrics:
I love to think of my dear Lord,
For He has done so much for me,
He’s shown me to the narrow road,
That leads me on to Calvary.

Now, in a song of grateful praise,
To my dear Lord, my voice I’ll raise;
With all His saints, I’ll join to tell,
That Jesus hath done all things well.

563.lyrics:
Now I have a dear Friend,
Jesus is mine,
His love shall never end,
Jesus is mine;
Though earthly joys decrease,
Though earthly friendships cease,
Now I have lasting peace,
Jesus is mine.

Though I grow poor and old,
Jesus is mine,
Though I grow pale and cold,
Jesus is mine;
He shall my wants supply,
His precious blood is nigh,
Naught can my hopes destroy,
Jesus is mine.

When earth shall pass away,
Jesus is mine,
In the great judgment day,
Jesus is mine;
Oh, what a glorious thing,
Then to behold my King,
On tuneful harps to sing,
Jesus is mine.

564.lyrics:
There is a home, a peaceful home,
A home of joy and love,
And them that bear the cross below,
Shall wear a crown above.

Chorus:

My home, sweet home,
My beautiful home above,
Sweet home of love,
My beautiful home above.

565.lyrics:
We’re marching thru this world below,
We’re trav’ling thru this world of woe,
To that bright world
Where all is peace and love.
We’re marching thru this world below,
We’re marching to a world above,
Where all is peace and love.

566.lyrics:
I have friends beyond the sky,
Dwelling in that peaceful land,
Some day we’ll meet them by and by,
And join the heav’nly band,
Some day we’ll join that happy angel band.

Chorus:

O blessed day when I shall be
With Him who died for me,
With Him who made me free,
We’ll join the happy angel band,
And sing at God’s right hand.

Will you come and go with me,
To the land beyond death’s sea?
With friends and loved ones there to be,
Is a home for you and me,
We’re going home to that sweet home some day.

(Chorus)

567.lyrics:
Father, I wait before Thy throne,
Call me a child of Thine,
Send down the Spirit of Thy Son,
To form my heart divine.

Then shed Thy promised love abroad,
And make my comfort strong.
Then shall I say my Father God,
With an unwav’ring tongue.

568.lyrics:
Brother, thou art gone to rest,
We will not weep for thee;
For thou art now when oft on earth,
Thy spirit longed to be,

Chorus:

Gone to rest, with the blest,
To that bright beautiful shore,
There to sing to the King,
Safe at home for evermore.

Brother, thou art gone to rest,
Thy toils and cares are o’er,
And sorrow, pain and suffering now,
Shall never grieve thee more.

(Chorus)

Brother, thou art gone to rest,
Thy sins are all forgiven,
And saints in light have welcomed thee,
To share the joys of heav’n.

(Chorus)

Brother, thou art gone to rest,
And this shall be our pray’r,
That when we reach our journey’s end,
Thy glory we may share.

(Chorus)

metadata.Title: He Leads Me All the Way
metadata.Collation: He Leads Me All the Way

569.lyrics:
My Savior leads me ev’ry day,
Through life’s long weary road;
He guides my feet along the way,
And to the throne of grace.
My Savior leads me ev’ry day,
Thro’ ev’ry trial and fear;
Is ever near, my heart to cheer,
He leads me all the way.

570.lyrics:
Life is the time to serve the Lord,
The time to seek the great reward,
And while the lamp holds out to burn,
The vilest sinner may return.
The God we worship here below,
Will guide us all until we die,
He is our Saviour as we go,
Our King above the sky.

571.lyrics:
Christ went a building to prepare,
Not made with hands,
And ’twill be decked with jewels rare,
Not made with hands.

Chorus:

I know, I know
I have another building;
I know, I know
Not made with hands.

Put on the armour of our God,
Not made with hands,
And take the path our captain trod,
Not made with hands.

(Chorus)

With shield of faith defy the foe,
Not made with hands,
Until you hear the trumpet blow,
Not made with hands.

(Chorus)

That city’s built with precious stone,
Not made with hands,
Within we’ll gather round the throne,
Not made with hands.

(Chorus)

metadata.Title: We Will Sing with Angels There
metadata.Collation: We Will Sing with Angels There

572.lyrics:
There is a place called heaven,
The homeland of the soul,
The angels will be singing there,
While endless ages roll.

Chorus:

We will sing with the angels there,
In that happy home so fair,
In heaven above where all is love,
We will sing with the angels there.

That home is made of jasper,
Its walks are laid with gold,
The beauties of that heav’nly place,
Have never yet been told.

(Chorus)

There we shall live forever,
In that eternal home,
We’ll meet our Savior face to face,
Around that happy throne.

(Chorus)

573.lyrics:
Brightly doth His spirit shine,
Into this poor heart of mine,
While He leads I cannot fall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

Chorus:

Trusting as the moments fly,
Trusting as the days go by,
Trusting Him whate’er may fall,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

Singing if my way is clear,
Praying if the path is drear,
If in danger for Him call,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

(Chorus)

Trusting Him while life shall last,
Trusting Him till earth is past,
’Till within the jasper walls,
Trusting Jesus, that is all.

(Chorus)

574.lyrics:
May grace and truth,
Sweet peace and rest
Dwell in each breast,
Sweet peace and rest.

575.lyrics:
Awake and sing the song,
Of Moses and the Lamb,
Tune ev’ry heart and ev’ry tongue,
To praise the Savior’s name.

Soon shall we hear Him say,
‘Ye blessed children, come!’
Soon will He call us hence away
To our eternal home.

576.lyrics:
O what amazing words of grace
Are in the gospel found;
Suited to ev’ry sinner’s case,
Who knows the joyful sound.

Chorus:

Who knows the gospel sound,
Suited to ev’ry sinner’s case,
Who knows the joyful gospel sound.

Poor, sinful, needy, thirsty souls
Are freely welcomed here;
Salvation like a river rolls,
Abundant, free and clear.

(Chorus)

‘Whoever will,’ O gracious word!
Shall of this stream partake;
Come, thirsty souls, and bless the Lord,
And drink for Jesus’ sake.

(Chorus)

metadata.Title: Forever Blest
metadata.Lyrics: Mills, Elizabeth King (1st, 2nd, & 3rd Verses); Broaddus and Broaddus’ Collection of Sacred Ballads (4th Verse)

577.lyrics:
Sweet land of rest for thee I sigh,
When will the moments come,
When I shall lay my armor by,
And dwell with Christ at home.

Chorus:

Come sinner to the gospel feast
And be forever blest.

No tranquil joys on earth I know,
No peaceful shelt’ring dome;
This world’s a wilderness of woe,
This world is not my home.

(Chorus)

Weary of wand’ring round and round
This vale of sin and gloom,
I long to leave the unhallowed ground,
And dwell with Christ at home.

(Chorus)

When we’ve been there ten thousand years
Bright shining as the sun;
We’ve no less days to sing God’s praise,
Than when we first begun.

(Chorus)

578.lyrics:
I have heard the gospel message sent to us today,
God is love, God is love,
And I know that Christ redeemed me, He’s the truth, the way,
Hallelujah! God is love, God is love.

Chorus:

I’ve heard the news, the Savior reigns,
A place in heav’n for all remains,
His blood has cleansed sin’s deepest stains;
God is love, God is love, our God is love.

Can my lips be mute then longer when such gifts are mine,
God is love, God is love,
When the Savior says so sweetly, ‘All is freely thine,’
Hallelujah! God is love, God is love.

(Chorus)

There’ll be shouting at the coming of the Lord and King,
God is love, God is love,
And His loyal ones will gather round the throne and sing,
Hallelujah! God is love, God is love.

(Chorus)

I will sing the glad new anthem with the host above,
God is love, God is love,
With the saved I am now sharing in His wondrous love,
Hallelujah! God is love, God is love.

(Chorus)

580.lyrics:
Lord Jesus, I’m not worthy
On Thee to call or look,
Nor have my name recorded
In the everlasting Book;
For wealth and earthly pleasures,
But little do I care;
O give to me a welcome
To mansions over there.

Chorus:

We may not know of the joy untold,
The bliss in paradise;
But when I come to the gate of gold,
I believe it will open wide.

The walls of heaven’s garnished
With jewels rich and rare,
This is the place He promised
That He would for us prepare;
The crystal sea there glistens,
The Book of Life is there,
And John did look and listen
To wonders over there.

(Chorus)

581.lyrics:
There is a house not made with hands,
Eternal and on high;
And here my spirit waiting stands,
’Till God shall bid it fly.

Shortly this prison of my clay,
Must be dissolved and fall;
Then O, my soul, with joy obey,
Thy heav’nly Father’s call.

I long to see my friends again,
And hear them sweetly say;
‘Come, weary dove, here is thy home,
Then fold thy wings and stay.’

582.lyrics:
Long ago we were boys in the ranks, comrades,
Our hearts light, and happy as the day,
Cheeks were ruddy, eyes bright, locks were dark, comrades,
As we marched from our home far away.

Chorus:

But now we are aged and gray, comrades,
The trials of life are nearly done,
But to us life’s as dear as it was, comrades,
When you and I were young.

Long ago we were marching away, comrades,
Our flags to the breeze gaily flung,
Our bosoms were bare to the foe, comrades,
When you and I were young.

(Chorus)

Long ago we were camping in storms, comrades,
Our courage and muscles tautly strung,
Our hearts set on vict’ry or death, comrades,
When you and I were young.

(Chorus)

583.lyrics:
From whence does this union arise,
That hatred is conquer’d by love?
It fastens our souls with such ties,
That distance and time can’t remove.

It cannot in Eden be found,
Nor yet in Paradise lost;
It grows on Immanuel’s ground,
And Jesus’ dear blood it did cost.

My friends once so dear unto me,
Our souls so united in love:
Where Jesus is gone we shall be,
In yonder blest mansions above.

metadata.Title: I Love to Sing of Jesus
metadata.Collation: I Love to Sing of Jesus

584.lyrics:
I love to sing of Jesus,
And of the wondrous plan,
He has laid for our salvation,
Redeeming sinful man.

Chorus:

He is Alpha, and Omega,
Let the people praise the Lord from shore to shore.
Hallelujah, hallelujah,
Praise the Lord, O praise the Lord for evermore.

I love to read of beauties
In Revelation’s Book,
When the doors of heaven opened,
And John did take a look.

(Chorus)

585.lyrics:
Come, sinners, to the gospel feast,
Let ev’ry soul be Jesus’ guest,
Ye need not one be left behind,
For God hath bidden all mankind.

Sent by my Lord, on thee I call,
The invitation is to all;
Come, all the world, come sinner, thou,
All things in Christ are ready now.

See Him set forth before your eyes,
That precious, bleeding sacrifice;
His offered benefits embrace,
And freely now be saved by grace.

586.lyrics:
While trav’ling down life’s weary road,
I often turn aside
In answer to my Master’s call,
He says ‘Come rest, abide.’
He sets me by a cooling stream,
To rest in Eden’s shade,
And wipes this dusty pilgrim’s feet,
If I have but obeyed.

And countless days of mirth I’ve spent,
And sweet has been the wine,
While trav’ling thru this world below,
My will suborned to thine.
His own soft hand shall dry my tears,
And hold me to his breast,
Then take me homeward thru the skies,
Unto the trav’ler’s rest.

587.lyrics:
Nearer, my God, to Thee;
Nearer to Thee;
E’en tho’ it be a cross
That raiseth me!
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer my, God, to Thee!

Tho’ like a wanderer,
Daylight all gone,
Darkness be over me,
My rest a stone;
Yet in my dreams I’d be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee.

There let the way appear,
Steps unto heav’n,
All that Thou sendest me,
In mercy giv’n;
Angels to beckon me,
Nearer, my God, to Thee.

Or if on joyful wing,
Cleaving the sky,
Sun, moon and stars forgot,
Upward I fly,
Still all my song shall be,
Nearer, my God, to Thee.

588.lyrics:
How beauteous are their feet,
Who stand on Zion’s hill;
Who bring salvation on their tongues,
And words of peace reveal;
How charming, charming is their voice,
How sweet the tidings are!
Zion, behold thy Saviour King,
He reigns and triumphs here!

589.lyrics:
If I must die, O let me die
With hope in Jesus’ blood,
That saves from sin and reconciles to God.
O let me die in peace with God
And leave these fleeting joys below.

590.lyrics:
My Savior and my King,
Thy beauties are divine,
Thy lips with blessings overflow,
And ev’ry grace is thine.

The smilings of Thy face,
How amiable they are;
’Tis heav’n to rest in thine embrace
And nowhere else but there.

591.lyrics:
Our fathers who have gone before,
Have set before our eyes,
The path that we should follow on,
Until we reach the skies.
We call to mind their kind ways,
Their tender mercies giv’n,
We feel their presence ever near,
When e’er we sing of heav’n.

Our tears of grief shall be replaced,
With mem’ries sweet and clear,
And owe to Jesus boundless grace,
The hope that we hold dear.
Of sweet reunion on high.
With those who’ve gone before,
Whose faith already is made sight,
And praise Him evermore.

The fellowship by Adam lost,
Has been to us restored,
The penalty of sin was paid,
By Jesus Christ, our Lord.
The Spirit in our heart moves,
And testifies of grace,
We long to residence above,
And see His loving face.

592.lyrics:
The Lord, the Judge, before His throne
Bids all the earth draw near;
The nations near the rising sun,
And near the western sky.
Throned on a cloud our God shall come,
Bright flames prepare His way,
Thunder and darkness, fire and smoke,
Lead on the dreadful day.

‘But gather all my saints,’ He cries,
‘That made their peace with God
By the Redeemer’s sacrifice,
And seal’d it with His blood.
Their faith and works, brought forth to light
Shall make the world confess
My sentence of reward is right,
And heav’n adore my grace.’

594.lyrics:
Great God of nations now to Thee,
Our hymn of gratitude we raise,
With humble heart and bending knee,
We offer Thee our song of praise.

Chorus:

Great God preserve us in thy fear;
In dangers still our guardian be:
O spread Thy truth’s bright precepts here;
Let all the people worship Thee.

Thy name we bless, Almighty God,
For all the kindness Thou hast shown,
To this fair land the Pilgrims trod,
This land we fondly call our own.

(Chorus)
